name: Bot Play
description: A botplay for people who lack skill.

name: Bot Play Rating
description: Which rating Bot Play always hits on its own, without you pressing anything. Humanized plays almost perfectly but deliberately misses notes that come too fast for a human to actually hit.

name: Big Assist Rating
description: Any key you press, roughly on time, instantly becomes this rating.

name: Hold Key
description: Hold down an arrow while a bunch of notes are coming and every note on that arrow gets hit automatically for as long as you hold it.

name: Hold Key Rating
description: Which rating the notes get while you're holding the key down.

name: Easy Double Notes
description: Press just one key in a chord (two notes, three, whatever) and every note in it gets hit at once.

name: Easy Double Notes Rating
description: Which rating the extra notes in the chord get.

name: Fake Keyboard Color
description: Color of the fake keyboard's keys.

name: Fake Keyboard Size
description: How big the fake keyboard is on screen.

name: Fake Keyboard Position
description: Downscroll keeps it at the top, Upscroll moves it to the bottom.

name: Hitbox Size
description: Makes the note hitbox bigger so you miss less. 100% = normal timing, adjust as you like.

name: Credits
description: Shows who made this mod on screen.

name: Show On-Screen Text
description: Shows the text 'Botplay: ON' in the corner while Bot Play is active.
